people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Hadadezer
people.line: King of Zobah, defeated by David.

people.name: Rehob
people.line: Father of Hadadezer, king of Zobah

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: David struck also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
translations.bsb: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River.
translations.kjv: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
translations.asv: David smote also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
